lt.event: Spalio 28 d., Šv. apaštalai Simonas ir Judas (F)
lt.line: Visa minia stengėsi jį paliesti, nes iš jo ėjo galia ir visus gydė.

en.event: Feast of Saints Simon and Jude, Apostles
en.line: When day came, he called his disciples to himself, and from them he chose Twelve, whom he also named Apostles: Simon, whom he named Peter, and his brother Andrew, James, John, Phil
